nodes.name: Verify HMAC & flatten
nodes.notes: Reads $env.SHOPIFY_API_SECRET — the SAME variable app/api/webhooks/shopify/route.ts uses, and the same value as SHOPIFY_API_SECRET in .env.local (Shopify's app client secret, shpss_…). An earlier version of this node read $env.SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET, a name that exists nowhere in this project, so it threw on every real delivery before reaching the database. The container must be started with -e SHOPIFY_API_SECRET=… for this to work at all; n8n has no access to .env.local.

parameters.query:
-- Idempotent on purpose: Shopify retries a webhook it did not get a 2xx
-- for, so the same order legitimately arrives more than once. Keyed on
-- shopify_order_id so a retry updates rather than duplicating.
insert into orders (
  shopify_order_id, order_number, total, discount_total, currency,
  financial_status, processed_at, cancelled_at, line_count, unit_count,
  product_titles
) values (
  $1, $2, $3::numeric, $4::numeric, $5, $6::financial_status_t,
  $7::timestamptz, $8::timestamptz, $9::int, $10::int, $11::text[]
)
on conflict (shopify_order_id) do update set
  financial_status = excluded.financial_status,
  cancelled_at     = excluded.cancelled_at,
  total            = excluded.total
returning id, order_number, financial_status;

nodes.name: Upsert order
nodes.notes: Needs a WRITE credential, not cadence_agent — that role is read-only by design. Use the scoped cadence_n8n_writer role (insert+update on orders only), NOT the app's superuser DATABASE_URL: n8n credentials are not covered by the same review path as app code, and this node only needs one INSERT … ON CONFLICT.

nodes.name: 200 OK
nodes.notes: Shopify retries for ~48h unless it gets a 2xx. Always answer.
